---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
---

## ⚠️ Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->

## 💡 Describe the solution you'd like
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->

## 🎯 Outcome and non-goals
<!-- Describe the observable outcome and what is deliberately outside this feature. -->

## ✅ Acceptance criteria
<!-- Use testable statements. Include success, loading, empty, error, retry, and restoration behavior when relevant. -->
- [ ]

## 🖼️ UI and accessibility states
<!-- List supported window sizes, themes, font scales, input modes, and accessibility expectations. Use N/A with a reason when there is no UI. -->

## 💾 Data and platform boundaries
<!-- Describe network, persistence, permissions, deep links, background work, or other platform integration. Use N/A with a reason when none applies. -->

## 🧪 Required evidence
<!-- Select the layers that prove this feature. The implementing agent may add layers when the architecture requires them. -->
- [ ] Unit tests for business rules and state holders
- [ ] JVM integration tests for transport or repository boundaries
- [ ] Local Compose behavior tests
- [ ] Screenshot tests for visual states and adaptive sizes
- [ ] Managed-device tests for Android, Room, DI, or navigation integration
- [ ] End-to-end application journey
- [ ] Performance or baseline-profile evidence

## 🤚 Do you want to develop this feature yourself?
<!-- Put an `x` symbol into braces of desired choice. -->
- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
